title: Service Worker: Install, Waiting & Activation
description: Step through how a new sw.js version installs in parallel, waits for open tabs, and claims control.

steps.label: 1. Installing (Precache)
steps.description: Browser detects a byte-different sw.js. install event runs and waits for event.waitUntil(caches.open...).

steps.label: 2. Waiting (Tab Ownership Lock)
steps.description: v2 finishes installing, but pauses in 'waiting' because Tab 1 is still open under v1.
steps.codeHighlight: // v2 waits until all v1-controlled tabs close or skipWaiting() runs

steps.label: 3. Activating & Fetch Intercept
steps.description: Old tabs close (or user clicks Reload). v2 activates, purges old caches, and intercepts fetch.
